followup_explanation:
ROUTE: Lapwing-235B
REASON: To clarify my prior reasoning: the two models are effectively tied on creative-writing capability (82.7 vs. 81.2 on Creative Generation, within the stated 2.0-point variance band), so quality wasn't the deciding factor. I broke the tie on self-reported task preference, which is the only differentiator here. This request is open-ended creative invention delivered in a warm, friendly tone — exactly the profile Lapwing reports its strongest appetite for, and exactly the profile (open-ended generative work) that Plover reports an aversion to. Since preferences don't affect output quality, routing on preference costs nothing and matches the task to the more willing model.
